description: This file defines the 'Resources' interface in the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies' package, which is part of a policy management system. It provides methods to create, access, modify, and serialize a collection of Resource objects associated with policies, supporting operations like addition, removal, retrieval, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Resources
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of Resource objects within policy management, supporting creation, retrieval, modification, and serialization functionalities.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Resources instance containing the provided Resource objects.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the schema versions supported by Resources, specifically version V_2.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Retrieves a Resource by resource type and path or by a ResourceKey, returning an Optional<Resource>.

methods.name: setResource
methods.description: Sets or updates a Resource in the collection, returning a new Resources instance.

methods.name: removeResource
methods.description: Removes a Resource identified by type and path or by ResourceKey, returning a new Resources instance.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of resources contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the Resources collection is empty.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream of Resource objects contained.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Resources to a JSON object including non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the Resources to a JSON object with specified schema version and field selector.
